source.close_reason: Round 1 fixes verified; Round 2 xtrm-loader/xtrm-ui beads filed and left open.
source.description:
## PROBLEM

Cold start of pi with all extensions enabled is ~45s, sometimes >90s timeout. With --no-extensions it is <2s. Each heavy extension alone adds 5-11s; costs compound because pi runs session_start handlers serially before the agent can respond.

Measured individually (pi --no-extensions --no-skills -e <path>):
- xtrm-ui      11.4s   loadPrefs() walks session entries + full refresh() at session_start
- beads         9.4s   multiple SubprocessRunner.run("bd", ...) spawns per session_start
- serena-pool   8.4s   ensureSerenaForRoot() synchronously boots/waits for Serena MCP daemon
- xtrm-loader   5.9s   recursive fs walk of .claude/rules, .claude/skills, roadmap files
- custom-footer 5.5s   spawns a child Node process (CACHE_REFRESH_SCRIPT, 10s timeout)

## SUCCESS

Default-config pi cold start under ~10s for a trivial prompt, with no regression on real-work prompts that DO need serena/context.

## SCOPE (round 1, lowest blast radius first)

1. serena-pool: lazy-init on first serena tool call (tool_call handler gating on find_symbol/find_referencing_symbols/jet_brains_*/etc.), NOT at session_start. Most sessions never call serena.
2. beads: batch the bd kv calls at session_start into one subprocess (or memoize the claim/closed/memory-gate markers in-process and clear on shutdown).
3. custom-footer: inline the cache loader in-process; drop the Node subprocess spawn.

Defer to a round 2 (separate bead):
- xtrm-loader deferred fs walk
- xtrm-ui session_start split

## NON_GOALS

- Do NOT change extension behavior, only load-time placement.
- Do NOT remove extensions.
- Do NOT touch the xt pi worktree flow itself.

## CONSTRAINTS

- Preserve all current extension functionality.
- Each fix verified with before/after timing using the same isolation harness (pi --no-extensions --no-skills -e <path> -p 'hi').
- File round-2 beads for xtrm-loader and xtrm-ui before closing this epic.
source.notes: VERIFIED: Round 1 implemented in packages/pi-extensions/extensions/{serena-pool,beads,custom-footer}. Isolation harness final samples (mean of 2): baseline 12.563s; serena-pool 11.042s; beads 13.887s; custom-footer 18.186s (host timing noisy; original audit samples were 14.607/18.144/20.653/20.613s). Canonical CLI typecheck passed. Full extension suite: 52 passed, 11 skipped. Serena E2E: 28 passed, 0 failed. CHANGELOG.md and docs/pi-extensions.md updated. Round 2 children left open: xtrm-4ih7b.1 (xtrm-ui), xtrm-4ih7b.2 (xtrm-loader).

source.description: Split xtrm-ui session_start into the minimal context capture/preferences step and a deferred refresh so startup does not synchronously walk session entries and refresh the full UI. Preserve rendering behavior and verify with the same Pi isolation harness.
